description: Conformance vectors for the SRL content-addressed storage abstraction and T7 volume identity guard (WP-C20). Three synthetic mount-info documents (a mounted_expected volume with the fake UUID 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001, a mounted_foreign volume with a distinct UUID, and an absent case descriptor where the provider raises T7UnavailableError), one tiny fixture blob (<1 KiB) for the store round-trip, and one oversized synthetic descriptor (declared size > 1 MiB, no real bytes) for the fallback single-object limit refusal. All UUIDs are fake; no vector touches a real disk. The mount_info mount_point fields are pre-redacted to digest-prefix tokens so the fixtures themselves never carry a raw /Volumes/ or /Users/ path.

vectors.name: mount_info-mounted-expected
vectors.description: The expected volume is mounted at the expected point; identity verifies.

vectors.name: mount_info-mounted-foreign
vectors.description: A different volume is mounted at the expected point; the store fails closed (WRONG_T7_VOLUME).

vectors.name: mount_info-absent
vectors.description: No volume is mounted at the expected point; the store waits (WAIT_STORAGE).

vectors.name: tiny-fixture-blob
vectors.description: A <1 KiB public fixture blob accepted by the local store round-trip and the fallback.

vectors.name: oversized-descriptor
vectors.description: A descriptor with declared size > 1 MiB (no real bytes) the fallback must refuse with WAIT_STORAGE.
